subtitle: Lesson 18 · Training Deep Networks in Practice

code:
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.1)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(
    optimizer, step_size=30, gamma=0.1
)

for epoch in range(100):
    train_one_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer)
    scheduler.step()
caption: Cuts the learning rate to 10% of its value every 30 epochs.

code:
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
    optimizer, T_max=50
)

for epoch in range(50):
    train_one_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer)
    scheduler.step()
caption: Decays along a cosine curve toward zero over T_max epochs.

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=5
)

for epoch in range(epochs):
    train_one_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer)
    val_loss = evaluate(model, val_loader, loss_fn)
    scheduler.step(val_loss)
caption: Decays only when val_loss stops improving for `patience` epochs.
